note: Discriminating knowledge-delivery eval. Each case is a Rust question needing SPECIFIC, checkable guidance. keyFacts are correct-answer elements defined from Rust correctness (NOT copied from skill content). The eval measures whether the plugin routes to a skill whose injected window actually DELIVERS at least one keyFact. Baseline (no plugin) delivers 0 by construction. Skills must NOT be edited to make cases pass — a miss is a revealed content gap.

cases.prompt: 撮合引擎用 Rust 实现，订单金额怎么避免浮点误差
A Rust firmware module must run with no_std and cannot allocate. Design logging without Vec or String.
A Rust async handler locks a std::sync::Mutex and does network I/O while holding the guard, and stalls under load.
A Rust wrapper fills an out-parameter buffer from a C function using MaybeUninit. How to avoid reading uninitialized memory?
A Rust library exposes anyhow::Error from public functions. When should it expose typed errors instead?
A Rust crate wants a newly stabilized std API but promises an older MSRV to downstream users.
A Rust API returns E0382 after a value is moved into a helper and reused by the caller. Redesign without clone-everywhere.
A plugin registry wants Vec<Box<dyn Plugin>>, but Plugin has generic methods and returns Self. Why is this not object safe?
A Rust function iterates a Vec immutably while pushing derived items into the same Vec and hits E0502.
A Rust async type stores a pointer to one of its own fields then moves the struct after polling.
A Rust global cache uses static mut and raw pointers. What are the data-race risks and safer primitives?
Review the safety contract for exposing a Rust slice over a raw C pointer and length before a safe wrapper.
